LEARN WITH AIVORAH — SIMPLIFIED

You will learn to identify and speak basic English words and phrases related to animals and objects
WHAT YOU'LL LEARN

You will learn to identify and speak basic English words and phrases related to animals and objects

You will learn to recognize and repeat words with two syllables

You will learn to develop vocabulary related to everyday life and animals
THE POEM
Let us speak mon key monkey don key donkey bas ket basket sell er seller
A fat cat sat on a mat. “I can catch you, little rat”, said the cat.
The lid of the box did not open. “Ha, ha! You can’t catch me, big cat!”, said the rat.
We can learn new words by repeating them. For example, we can say 'mon key' to mean monkey.
We can also learn about animals like cats and rats. Cats like to catch rats, but rats are very fast.
We can use words like 'cat', 'rat', and 'mat' to talk about everyday things.
Let's practice saying these words and learn more about animals and objects.
